items.q: [INTERVIEWER] There's an interesting story. Oliver Nelson, around 1969 or so, did a tour of Africa... [INTERVIEWEE] Sure, sure.

There's an interesting story. Oliver Nelson, around 1969 or so, did a tour of Africa with a seven or eight piece band and he said, it's an interesting thing that you have in African music some very sophisticated things about it, melodies, rhythms.
Sure, sure. Which are now ours, because the world is no longer regional.
